Light 0.0.4 adds a split Markdown workflow and fixes several cross-platform editing issues.

## Editor

- Switch between the regular WYSIWYG editor and a two-pane Markdown source / live preview view.
- The selected editor mode is remembered on the current device.
- Switching back to WYSIWYG rebuilds the document from the Markdown source, preserving headings, lists, tables, media, and other structured content.

## Nested tags

- Tags such as `work/project/light` are now presented as an explicit breadcrumb instead of looking like a single unprocessed string.
- Creating a nested tag immediately builds the corresponding expandable hierarchy in the sidebar while keeping the portable slash-based frontmatter format.

## Fixes

- Prevent repeated AI continuation text when an OpenAI-compatible endpoint returns cumulative streaming snapshots instead of standard deltas.
- Make board card drag and drop start reliably in Linux desktop WebViews by providing a real, portable drag payload.
- Clear board drag state when a drag is cancelled outside a column.

## Quality

- Added regression coverage for cumulative AI streams, nested tag paths, editor view rebuilding, and desktop board drag payloads.
- Passed 1,049 automated frontend tests, the production web build, and all native Rust/Tauri tests before release.

## Downloads

- Windows x64 — NSIS installer
- Linux x64 — AppImage and Debian package
- macOS Apple Silicon — application bundle and DMG
- macOS Intel — application bundle and DMG

Installers are attached as each platform's build completes. The binaries are not code-signed yet; Windows and macOS may display a warning on first launch.
